'''Unidentified Duroonian flyers''' were spotted by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] after nightfall on the planet [[Duroon]] during his adventures there in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. They were lacy, thin, and white, which flew through the air with a swimming, rippling motion.
